result.instructions: Tools for Sienge, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which customers were added to Sienge this month?"; "Show the open receivable bills and their installments for customer 45."; "Which purchase orders are still pending delivery?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Sienge data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sienge_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sienge_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sienge_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. sienge_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sienge_list_customers
tools.description: List the customers of the Sienge account, ordered by id. Filter by CPF or CNPJ, enterprise, or create and change dates. GET /customers.

cpf.description: Only the customer with this CPF (11 digits).

cnpj.description: Only the customer with this CNPJ (14 digits).

enterpriseId.description: Only customers linked to this enterprise id.

createdAfter.description: Created on or after this date (yyyy-MM-dd).

createdBefore.description: Created on or before this date (yyyy-MM-dd).

modifiedAfter.description: Changed on or after this date (yyyy-MM-dd).

modifiedBefore.description: Changed on or before this date (yyyy-MM-dd).

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 200 (the API default is 100).

tools.name: sienge_get_customer
tools.description: Show one customer with its phones, addresses, agents, procurators, spouse and family income. GET /customers/{customerId}.

tools.name: sienge_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer: a natural person (personType F, needs cpf and sex) or a legal person (personType J, needs cnpj). POST /customers. The call is never retried: check sienge_list_customers before you create the same customer again.

personType.description: F = natural person (needs cpf and sex). J = legal person (needs cnpj).

name.description: Full name, or the company name for a legal person.

cpf.description: CPF of a natural person (11 digits).

sex.description: Sex of a natural person: F or M.

cnpj.description: CNPJ of a legal person (14 digits).

typeId.description: Customer type id from the customer-type register of the Sienge account.

tools.name: sienge_list_companies
tools.description: List the companies (business units) of the Sienge account, ordered by id. GET /companies.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 200 (the API default is 100).

tools.name: sienge_list_enterprises
tools.description: List the enterprises (construction projects) of the account. Filter by company or type. GET /enterprises.

companyId.description: Only enterprises of this company id.

type.description: Enterprise type code, 1 to 4, as the Sienge register defines it.

receivableRegister.description: Receivables register used by the enterprise.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 200 (the API default is 100).

tools.name: sienge_list_creditors
tools.description: List the creditors (suppliers and other payees), filtered by CPF, CNPJ or name. GET /creditors.

cpf.description: Only the creditor with this CPF (11 digits).

cnpj.description: Only the creditor with this CNPJ (14 digits).

creditor.description: Only creditors whose name contains this text.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 200 (the API default is 100).

tools.name: sienge_get_creditor
tools.description: Show one creditor with its contacts, phones, address, bank data and tax classification. GET /creditors/{creditorId}.

tools.name: sienge_list_sales_contracts
tools.description: List sales contracts, filtered by customer, company, enterprise, unit, number or dates. GET /sales-contracts.

customerId.description: Only contracts of this customer id.

companyId.description: Only contracts of this company id.

enterpriseId.description: Only contracts of this enterprise id.

unitId.description: Only contracts of this unit id.

number.description: Only the contract with this number.

createdAfter.description: Created on or after this date (yyyy-MM-dd).

createdBefore.description: Created on or before this date (yyyy-MM-dd).

modifiedAfter.description: Changed on or after this date (yyyy-MM-dd).

modifiedBefore.description: Changed on or before this date (yyyy-MM-dd).

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 200 (the API default is 100).

tools.name: sienge_get_sales_contract
tools.description: Show one sales contract with its customers, units, payment conditions, brokers and commissions. GET /sales-contracts/{salesContractId}.

tools.name: sienge_list_receivable_bills
tools.description: List the receivable bills (accounts receivable titles) of one customer. GET /accounts-receivable/receivable-bills.

customerId.description: Customer id whose receivable bills to list (required).

companyId.description: Only bills of this company id.

costCenterId.description: Only bills of this cost center id.

paidOff.description: true = only paid bills, false = only open bills.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 200 (the API default is 100).

tools.name: sienge_list_receivable_installments
tools.description: List the installments (parcelas) of one receivable bill with due dates and amounts. GET /accounts-receivable/receivable-bills/{receivableBillId}/installments.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 200 (the API default is 100).

tools.name: sienge_list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List purchase orders by order date, status, approval, supplier or building. GET /purchase-orders.

supplierId.description: Only orders of this supplier (creditor) id.

buildingId.description: Only orders for this enterprise (building) id.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 200 (the API default is 100).

tools.name: sienge_get_purchase_order
tools.description: Show one purchase order: status, supplier, building, totals and payment condition. GET /purchase-orders/{purchaseOrderId}.

tools.name: sienge_list_purchase_invoices
tools.description: List purchase invoices (notas fiscais de compra) by issue period, company, supplier, document or number. GET /purchase-invoices.

companyId.description: Only invoices of this company id.

supplierId.description: Only invoices of this supplier (creditor) id.

documentId.description: Only the invoice with this document id.

number.description: Only the invoice with this number.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 200 (the API default is 100).

tools.name: sienge_list_units
tools.description: List the real-estate units (imóveis) of the account, ordered by id descending. GET /units.

enterpriseId.description: Only units of this enterprise id.

name.description: Only units whose name contains this text.

additionalData.description: ALL = include extra unit data, NONE = leave it out.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 200 (the API default is 100).

tools.name: sienge_get_unit
tools.description: Show one unit with its enterprise, areas, address, evaluations and groupings. GET /units/{unitId}.

tools.name: sienge_list_departments
tools.description: List the departments of the account, optionally filtered by name or active state. GET /departments.

name.description: Only departments whose name contains this text.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 200 (the API default is 100).
